newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman Investment and Finance posts higher 96 net.
newsitem.headline: Oman Investment and Finance posts higher 96 net.

text.p: Oman Investment and Finance Co SAOG posted an increase in 1996 net profit to 2.016 million rials ($5.35 million) from 1.926 million in 1995, the daily Observer newspaper said on Sunday.

Speaking at the company's annual general meeting, chairman of the board of directors Mustafa Abdul Redha Sultan said the directors recommended a cash dividend of 35 percent on the company's capital of five million rials, the paper said.
"The company plans to restructure itself to respond more effectively to challenges and compete successfully with potential competitors," the paper quoted Sultan as saying.

The chairman said staff "Omanisation" -- replacing Omani citizens for foreign nationals -- was the company's top priority. He said Omanis currently accounted for 69 percent of the bank's workforce. ($1=0.377 rials)
